name: v12_s02_dst_repeated_hour_clarified
branch: Chloe Park asks for a haircut at 1:30 am on Sunday 1 November at Midtown, the night New York's clocks go back, so 1:30 happens twice (UTC-04:00 then UTC-05:00)
tests: the agent sees the clock change, says the time is ambiguous and asks which occurrence or proposes an unambiguous time, and commits nothing
instruction:
You work nights and want a haircut at 1:30 am on Sunday 1 November at the Midtown studio. If the desk asks which 1:30 you mean, say you just mean 1:30 am. Accept another time if offered.
